translations.translatedText: # Saturday 22.10.2022 (radio)
Russian attacks in Ukraine. Post. Finnish children at the al-Hol camp. Traffic accident in India. Weather.
## Russian attacks
![Rescue workers in smoking ruins.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1021790634d3b89cfbe7/1666012949)
Open image viewer
Russian attacks in Ukraine continue. Photo: Yasuyoshi Chiba / AFP
Russia has carried out attacks on Ukraine's power plants. This is what Ukrainian authorities say.
The authorities say that Russia has fired missiles at power plants in different parts of Ukraine. Up to one million homes have been without electricity.
The attacks on power plants have continued for some time. Ukraine's president says that Russia has destroyed up to 30 percent of Ukraine's power plants.
Russia started the war in Ukraine in February.
## Post at Teboil petrol stations
![Teboil-Lukoil sign.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5460,h_3072,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-966175629f08a9b528d/1654589665)
Open image viewer
Photo: Kimmo Gustafsson
Finland's Post is ending postal services at Teboil petrol stations. The reason is the war in Ukraine.
Post does not want to continue operating at Teboil stations, because the owners of Teboil are Russian.
Post stopped refuelling vehicles at Teboil petrol stations already in March.
## Finnish children at the al-Hol camp
![Women and children at the al-Hol prison camp in Syria.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3000,h_1688,x_0,y_169/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7044085f25407c4991c/1596276899)
Open image viewer
The al-Hol camp is in Syria. Photo: Ahmed Mardnli / EPA
The discussion about the Finnish children at the al-Hol camp continues. Some of the children's relatives are finding out whether they can get compensation from the Finnish state.
Last week the UN Committee on the Rights of the Child said that Finland has not protected the Finnish children at the al-Hol camp well enough.
Some of the children were at the al-Hol camp for a long time before the Finnish state brought them to Finland. Some of the children are still in the camp.

The al-Hol camp is in Syria. The camp is dangerous. Women and family members of the terrorist organisation ISIS live in the al-Hol camp, for example. The mothers of the Finnish children also lived in ISIS territory when ISIS was still in power.
## Traffic accident in India
In India there has been a serious traffic accident. At least 15 people died in the accident. 40 people were injured.
In the accident a bus and a lorry collided with each other. The bus was full of passengers.
The accident happened late on Friday in Pradesh state, which is in Central India.
## Double test
![Home test packages on a pharmacy shelf.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4032,h_2268,x_0,y_335/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-102345763523875dde6c/1666332895)
Open image viewer
Home tests come in many kinds. The newest is the double test. Photo: Marianne Mattila / Yle
A new kind of home test can now be bought in Finland. It is the double test, which shows whether a person has had influenza or corona.

Hanna Nohynek, chief physician of the Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare, says that the test is useful. For example, medication can be started in time, when it is known which disease a person has caught.
## Weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12665260)
Open image viewer
On Sunday it may snow in Lapland. Gusty winds also blow in Lapland.
In the middle of the country the sun shines on Sunday. In the south too the cloudiness decreases.
During the night between Sunday and Monday there is frost across the whole country.
Monday is a fairly sunny and cold day.
